title: Master status shows a non-null diskHeadroom with free bytes and at least one kind of Mainworks disk use
description: Runs the loop's real disk headroom check on a running install with real Mainworks files, persists state, and checks that master status reports a non-null diskHeadroom with positive freeBytes and at least one kind with its size (GY-3743).

steps.name: master status shows non-null diskHeadroom with at least one kind and its size
